desc: B0 umbrella, current 2026-07-24: raw-object audit 080, artifact 081, delivery control 089, tethered release-object boot 100, and conditional dual-mode review 119 are done. Exact object 2371ee5d reached Alpine/OpenRC default runlevel, watchdog, panel shell, internal keyboard, and empty partitions. Preferred dual-mode 46237ade preserves that payload; exact version/Rust inputs need pinning before claiming full rebuild reproducibility. Ticket 082 still needs maintainer/macOS volume UUID, current-object backup/hash, selected manifest, and execution split. Approved runnable=false ticket 101 then owns separate cold-boot and DebugUSB trigger checks. U-Boot remains post-B0 ticket 025/B1. UPDATE 2026-07-25 (claude): BOTH enrolled B0 routes are now closed by evidence. (a) Enrolled object with APPENDED payload is root-caused dead — m1n1's payload scan address (base+0x10C000) contains m1n1's own .rodata (readmem shows '[AFK]%s send cmd:' from src/afk.c), so an appended payload can never be discovered; iBoot also reserves ~7.5 MiB of kernel-data from m1n1's base (top_of_kernel_data 0x10004FA8000 vs base 0x1000482C000). Payload objects failed at 22.2/15.2/9.02 MiB with m1n1 v1/v2/v3 while filler objects booted at 14/16 MiB, and the identical objects boot fine chainloaded. Evidence: done/2026-07-25-t6040-enrolled-payload-rootcause.md. (b) Upstream 'small stage 1 + chainload= stage 2 from NVMe' is dead — m1n1's own nvme_init() raises an async L2C SError on T6040 (ESR 0xbe000000, L2C_ERR_STS 0x82). Evidence: done/2026-07-25-t6040-nvme-probe-result.md. Remaining untethered route is stage 2 from USB, which needs a loader with mass-storage+FAT (m1n1 has none; U-Boot does) — see the new U-Boot stage-2 ticket. Tethered chainload remains the working configuration. UNBLOCKED 2026-07-25 (claude): the appended-payload B0 route is ALIVE. Root cause of every earlier enrolled failure was 16 KiB total-size misalignment (ticket 129); a padded object boots. No USB, NVMe, HPM or U-Boot dependency for B0.
